subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Each scenario shall carry a route — run-for-real, mocked, or manual-human — and no required behavior shall be dropped; a behavior not runnable in CI shall be routed mocked or manual, never omitted.
rationale: the honesty valve against mocking away the hard part; nothing silently dropped
fit_criterion: every fixture scenario carries exactly one route; a seeded not-CI-runnable behavior is routed mocked or manual and appears in the doc; zero required behaviors are absent from both the coverage map and the routes
